title: Lock order for enrollment: definitions (id order) before account; callers must not hold locks with a human actor
answers: What lock order must customer analytics relationship writers use?
Can I call relationships.assign with a person actor while holding the account lock?
Why recheck is_controlled after locking definitions?
body:
Every writer locks controlled definitions in id order first, then the Account row. _enroll_on_human_edit must run inside the mutation's transaction BEFORE _lock_or_raise on the account.
- It does unlocked reads first (controlled_definitions, existing controls) and returns early with no lock for non-human actors, uncontrolled relationships, and fully enrolled accounts.
- Then ownership.lock_definitions and re-checks is_controlled under the locks, since a definition can be uncontrolled between reads (tested by patching ownership.controlled_definitions).
- A caller already holding the account or a definition lock must not pass a person as actor (deadlock/order inversion); documented in the module docstring of logic/relationships.py.
- end_relationship reads definition_id (ended_at null filter) unlocked to find the definition before enrolling.
applies: logic/relationships.py mutation helpers and any new caller passing Actor.human
says: Relationship assignment caused a deadlock under concurrent account updates
Why does calling relationships assign with certain actors cause deadlocks
The enrollment logic deadlocks when updating accounts and relationships together
Concurrent writes to customer analytics are failing from lock ordering
search: Lock order invariant for enrollment mutations: definitions must be locked in id order before the Account row, and _enroll_on_human_edit must run before _lock_or_raise within the transaction. A caller already holding an account or definition lock must not pass a human actor to avoid deadlock or order inversion. Applies to logic/relationships.py mutation helpers (_enroll_on_human_edit, end_relationship) and any new caller invoking ownership.lock_definitions or ownership.controlled_definitions with a human actor.
